label: reported

reported.how: Boat's usage record for sandbox bx_redacted: dollars at list price.

excluded: Boat's own meter weights machine-seconds by size (0.5, 1, 2 and 50/9 for small, default, large and xlarge) at $0.036 per hour of default (secondsPerDollar 100000); the flat per-size machine rates above are the same prices. The weighted-second form is what the usage record reports; per-sandbox cost comes from Boat's reported dollars.

Plan commitment: $20, $100, $500 or $2000 per month per seat; the plan price is not a fee and returns as VM time at the list rates. Included VM time expires at the end of the billing period; the plan also sets concurrent sandboxes (100, 300, 1,000, 2,000) and included starts.
Extra starts: create, fork and resume each count as one start; above the plan's included starts a start costs $0.03 to $0.07, paid from the wallet.

Saved snapshots above the included count (10 per $20 of plan per seat, never fewer than 10): $0.056 per snapshot per day, charged while sandboxes are stopped too. Automatic snapshots are kept while a sandbox runs and for 14 days after it stops, at no cost.
AI credentials proxy: $1 for each day it is on, plus $1 per 1,000 requests, paid from the wallet; it also charges while sandboxes are stopped.
Wallet payments of $200 or more get a bonus of 2% to 25%. The 7-day free trial (card required) limits compute, concurrency and sizes.
Egress: not billed ("Network traffic. boat does not bill egress.").
